note: Deep-dive #13. The guest has no account: Edge InPrivate with the microphone allowed. meeting saves its output in %TEMP%\hybrid-invite.json so lobby and connected can open the same guest link. Order: readiness (the day before), meeting, lobby, connected.
prepare: Push-Location src/api; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; npm test; Pop-Location
Push-Location src/join; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; npm test; Pop-Location
# owner signs in (device code), not recorded
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-13 -l westeurope -o none
az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-13 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam --query properties.outputs -o json > $env:TEMP\hybrid-outputs.json
az functionapp deployment source config-zip -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-13 -n $env:MG_FN13 --src ./hybrid-api.zip
(Invoke-WebRequest "$($env:MG_FN_URL13)/api/join").Content   # page asks for an invitation link
$env:MG_FN_KEY13 = az functionapp keys list -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-13 -n $env:MG_FN13 --query functionKeys.default -o tsv
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite -NoWelcome   # owner signs in as labadmin, consents once

# manual: write down and, only if the readiness check fails, change the Teams settings (Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -DisableAnonymousJoin $false, Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowAnonymousUsersToJoinMeeting $true, -AutoAdmittedUsers EveryoneInCompany); policy changes can take up to 24 hours
# manual: look up the Azure Communication Services price on the pricing page and write it in the README

screens.name: readiness
also: Expected: three rows Passed (tenant anonymous join, organizer policy, lobby). The owner signs in to Teams as labadmin if asked. Then (browser, labadmin): Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > Global > Meeting join & lobby with the matching settings. Mask the tenant name.

screens.name: meeting
mask: function host name in the guest link
tenant id and meeting id inside the Teams host link
all but the first four characters of the invite code
also: The function key is read from an environment variable into a SecureString and never printed. The saved JSON (guest link) is deleted in teardown.

screens.name: lobby
screens.url: file:///%TEMP%/hybrid-invite.json (read the GuestLink; open it in an Edge InPrivate window)
screens.account: labadmin (Teams on the web, host); guest has no account (InPrivate)
steps: Split the screen: left an Edge InPrivate window, right Teams on the web as labadmin
Right: join the meeting from HostJoin first (the guest cannot enter before a Teams user is present)
Left: open the GuestLink (from %TEMP%\hybrid-invite.json), name field 'Riley Guest', click Join
Left shows 'Waiting in the lobby. The host will let you in.'; right shows the lobby notification naming Riley Guest. Do NOT admit yet
mask: tenant name and Teams meeting id in the address bar
function host name in the guest page address

screens.name: connected
steps: As labadmin click Admit for Riley Guest
Guest page changes to 'You are in the meeting.' with Mute enabled
Teams participants list shows the guest labelled external
The guest unmutes and says one sentence (audio captured), then clicks Leave: the guest disappears from the participant list
mask: tenant name and Teams meeting id in the address bar

teardown: # manual: revert any Teams setting changed for readiness to the value written in the README; delete the meeting from the Teams calendar; close the InPrivate window
az group exists -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-13   # false once the delete has finished
needs: paid:Azure Communication Services usage (one guest, a few minutes)
